Figured I’d write here instead of making a new comment, but it seems like the clock widget has a soft incompatibility with Raid Overhaul. If I set it to system time, it of course shows my system time (which is also the raid time, unless I choose the “night” times, in which it’ll be 12 hours off), but it also doesn’t update by the second (not sure if it’s supposed to?) so when I go into my inventory it will show 10:45:36 and will stay that way until I navigate away from the menu showing the widget and going back to it.

It’s not a huge deal, I can just press O in-raid to see the time because of Raid Overhaul, but figured I’d make you aware
